gripOrHq.title: Fetal AI
gripOrHq.rulesText: When Runner accesses Fetal AI, do 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses Fetal AI from the Archives. If Fetal AI is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you. Runner must pay 2 to steal Fetal AI, in addition to any other costs.

gripOrHq.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

gripOrHq.title: Priority Requisition
gripOrHq.rulesText: You may rez a piece of ice, at no cost, when you score Priority Requisition.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Ice and Data’s Guide to the Net
discardCards.rulesText: Expose the outermost ice of each data fort.

rig.title: Smarteye
rig.rulesText: Once during each run, you may expose a piece of unrezzed ice as you approach it. You may then jack out before the Corp decides whether to rez the ice.

rig.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

ice.title: Sphinx 2006
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Sphinx 2006, you may pay [4], above the rez cost, to make it a sentry instead of a code gate.
